goal: Convert a candidate-independent preservation calibration pass into one exact, non-repeatable GPU experiment authorization without reopening heldout or scale.
procedure: Freeze the exact calibration receipt and policy hashes into the canonical training runner and experiment state. Require the calibration source revision to match. Claim the training output directory before GPU model work so duplicate submissions cannot silently become multiple experiments. Authorize exactly one P100 run. Keep test, frozen challenge, scale, parent retraining, private identity gradient, promotion, and N0 completion closed.
failure_doctrine: If the one model run fails, stop local repair. Re-evaluate the purpose of N0 and the failed component's role, localize the failure boundary, review relevant frontier research/models, and make at most one causal architectural change from that larger diagnosis. Do not automatically add steps, width, routers, thresholds, replay gradients, or hotfix versions.
constraints: fresh causal train quads are the only gradient-bearing data
ordinary and endpoint preservation are evaluation-only
notes: A bounded run is a causal diagnostic, not a declaration that the current width, depth, layer candidates, or training budget are final capability ceilings.
